name: Good Bar
blocked: Own Popmenu ordering page (address 1872 Rosecrans St, San Diego matches the work item exactly) shows category tabs (Sides, Burgers, Cheesesteaks, Chicken, Salads, Sandwiches, Bowls, Baskets, ToGo Drinks, Fries/Tots/Rings, Bites, Carnival Ticket) but most categories render empty. Confirmed this is a closed-store gate, not a genuinely thin menu: the page states 'Menu currently unavailable - Orders start at Friday, 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM' (checked in the evening, before that window), and the restaurant's own marketing page at goodbarsd.com/menus independently confirms priced Cheesesteaks exist (Classic $15.49, Aristocrat $15.49) that never appeared on the gated ordering page. A few items DID render regardless of the gate (1 Egg $1.50 under Sides; Mozzarella Sticks $9, Mini Churros $4, Cauliflower Bites Basket $10, Mini Corn Dog $10 under Bites; Carnival Ticket $10) but these are clearly a small subset, not the whole menu - the site's own branding as a cheesesteak specialist with zero cheesesteaks visible is the giveaway. Re-block and retry once ordering opens (Friday 12:30pm per the page) rather than recording these few items as the whole menu.

name: Bruegger's Bagels
blocked: Own ordering platform (orders.brueggers.com) resolves the correct location - address 655 West Broadway, San Diego CA 92101 matches the work item exactly - but the pickup-type modal reports 'Store is not accepting online orders at this time' with stated hours '6:00 AM to 2:00 PM PT' (checked in the evening, well outside that window) and does not let the menu render behind it even after selecting Walk-in / Later. This matches a chain-wide pattern already logged elsewhere in this project: two other Bruegger's locations were separately re-queued for 'a broken ordering backend' on 2026-08-26, so this is very likely systemic to the chain's ordering platform rather than specific to this store or this hour. The general brueggers.com/menu page carries no per-location prices and no JSON-LD Menu schema to fall back on. Re-block and retry during stated store hours (6am-2pm Pacific); if it fails again at that time, it corroborates the chain-wide backend issue rather than a clock problem.
